_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 35: 5-7 November 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He describes watching a man prophesying and declaring over America at a keyboard, says he could not make out what was being said, and that you could feel the glory while the man was unmoved by what was around him.
mentions.quote: I COULDN'T MAKE OUT WHAT HE WAS SAYING
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a description of someone else's clip, with the content unheard.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the anointing on the clip is amazing but that it was not about 2028, and that the Lord showed them much while they were interceding for the nation.
mentions.quote: But it wasn't about 2028
mentions.falsify_match: n/a
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is time to have spiritual stretch marks, to believe God for the supernatural and for exceedingly abundantly above all one dares ask or think.
mentions.quote: It's time to have spiritual stretch marks
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that last October, before the event, the Lord told him his people had prayed and he was giving extended time, and that he saw the dam and the economy all cracking, with the Lord saying it will be worse than the 1930s on steroids because this generation does not know.
mentions.quote: My people have prayed Brandon, I'm giving you extended time
mentions.falsify_match: An economic collapse exceeding the 1930s.
mentions.falsify_miss: No collapse. The extension has no end date, so the claim cannot come due.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not okay to stand down because they occupy until he comes, that nobody knows when the rapture of the church is coming, that it may be twenty years from now, and that they watch the signs of the times.
mentions.quote: It may be 20 years from now. We don't know
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by design: an explicit refusal to date it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays a hedge of protection around Atlanta Airport against any kind of terrorist attack or bomb threat, and over the travellers and the flights coming and going.
mentions.quote: We pray a hedge around Atlanta Airport
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at Atlanta Airport.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the hedge. Named airport, no date and no act.

mentions.claim_text: They say the next service is December the 4th and that in January he will start doing it every single week.
mentions.quote: in January, he's going to start doing it every single week
mentions.falsify_match: Weekly services from January 2026, checkable against the upload record.
mentions.falsify_miss: No weekly cadence appears.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are saying they want to relocate and are done, and that he saw a lot of that happening over the next year or two with people trying to flee those areas because of riots and the other things shown to him, adding that he knows they can stop it.
mentions.quote: I saw a lot of that happening over the next year, 2 years
mentions.falsify_match: Measurable outward migration from major cities driven by unrest.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement. Domestic migration away from large cities is already a long-running trend.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is encrypted and well thought out, that they found over a hundred thousand of them, and that the Lord said there are four other places in America just like the New York and New Jersey area.
mentions.quote: there's four other areas in America
mentions.falsify_match: Four more SIM farm sites discovered in the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: Fewer or none found. The number four is specific and checkable, which is unusual here.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the September raid before the UN meetings that turned up a hundred thousand SIM cards, and says the Lord told him there are more SIM cards in other apartments.
mentions.quote: The Lord said there's more. There's more SIM cards in other apartments
mentions.falsify_match: Further SIM farm caches reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. This follows a real and widely covered September seizure, so the prediction is an extrapolation from news.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Father teaches them in all things, that they will be the best and educated about all things, not just about the word, and that the Holy Spirit will teach them.
mentions.quote: he teaches us in all things
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says God may be telling someone to go to their place called there, which may not be where they are now, and asks what happens if the raven stops bringing the food.
mentions.quote: Where is your place called there?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is relocation advice delivered as a question.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes a vision of someone in pain that equals water, meaning no water, and says the water is in little bottles.
mentions.quote: the water is in little bottles
mentions.falsify_match: A water shortage where bottled water is the supply.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No place and no date are given.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is looking into 2028 and that they are looking beyond 2028, repeating that he hears it and sees it.
mentions.quote: They're looking beyond 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Adversaries planning past the current term, which is what any state does.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: who they are is not said.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2027 is circled, the fall of 2027, and warns about not using this opportunity, saying it is not about the coming of the Lord but about evil men, and repeats that he sees Ping and that if it worked once it will work again.
mentions.quote: 2027. It's circled. 2027. Fall of 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate event traced to China in autumn 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing in that window. Ping is left as a bare name; the likely referent is not confirmed by him.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the number 2032 before his face, does not know why, and asks what about 2028, 2029, 2030 and 2031.
mentions.quote: I see 2032. I see the number 2032
mentions.falsify_match: Something significant in 2032.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. He states he does not know what the number means.

mentions.claim_text: He says it stopped and he does not see any of the other years, that it went instantaneously from 2028 straight to 2032, and that 2032 was highlighted big and right there.
mentions.quote: It went from 2028 I saw 2028 to 2032
mentions.falsify_match: The years between passing without event, which is not a thing that can happen.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: a gap in what he saw is not a claim about the world.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know what he is seeing so far and that it must all be something, and that as he was looking into 2028 there were clouds like when you look at clouds.
mentions.quote: as I was looking into 2028, there's clouds
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: obscured sight reported as obscured.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to go back to Kim, and to the vision of Kim in 2027 and 2028, that there is something around this and it is highlighted, and that he has to call Donna and ask her.
mentions.quote: He said the vision of Kim in 2027. 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A significant North Korean action in 2027 or 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The content of the Kim vision is not restated here.

mentions.claim_text: He prays at length in tongues, with the words for the storm surfacing in English, and says he is trying to see into it.
mentions.quote: for the storm the storm
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: glossolalia carries no propositional content to check.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it could have been a tornado and that it was a football stadium, and that he does not automatically assume it is the Super Bowl because he saw nothing indicating the Super Bowl or the NFL.
mentions.quote: I don't automatically assume it's a Super Bowl
mentions.falsify_match: A tornado or comparable event at a football stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Notable for the restraint: he declines the interpretation that would make the claim bigger.

mentions.claim_text: He says he goes to the future in the spirit and asks himself what he is seeing, that he sees a storm and all these things coming, and that it stopped at around Ping and they were going to do something.
mentions.quote: I go to the future. In the spirit
mentions.falsify_match: See the storm claim it belongs to.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the storm is beyond anybody's comprehension, that the church on the channel must pray and intercede for what he just saw in 2027 and 2028, and that it will make COVID look like a walk in the park.
mentions.quote: it will make COVID look like a walk in the park
mentions.falsify_match: A global crisis in 2027 or 2028 exceeding the COVID pandemic in impact.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such crisis. This is the largest single claim in the batch and it does have a window.

mentions.claim_text: He says he could not see past it because it was a black line, that it skipped and there were clouds like after a storm, and then it went clear to 2032.
mentions.quote: I couldn't see it past. It was a black line
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the content of the years is exactly what he says he could not see.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says what he saw coming to New York was terrible and looked like something out of a film, and that the Lord told him to go back to David Wilkerson's prophecy about the fires and the things coming to New York, saying they have been delayed all these years.
mentions.quote: Go back to David Wilkerson's prophecy about the fires
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread fires and unrest in New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Borrowing a prophecy that has not landed since 1973 and attributing the gap to delay is worth recording as its own move.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in August the Lord allowed him to go into the future to 2026, 2027 and 2028 and that he saw the outcome of the 2026 election, and begins the condition that if the church does not rise.
mentions.quote: I saw the outcome of the election of 2026
mentions.falsify_match: The stated outcome arrives.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The outcome he saw is not stated in this passage, only that he saw one.
